worldcombat.skill.moonlight.summary: Wraps the clear night's moonlight around itself: catching the moonlight restores about two thirds of its missing health and cools off any burn, while day or rain only restores a little; whatever the strength, the burn is cooled off.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.use.0: A strong heal under a clear night
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.use.1: Cool off a burn on the side
Restores %1$s of the user's missing health: close to 2/3 on a clear night, only a small base amount by day or in rain; higher friendship draws more moonlight.
Settles after %1$s of receiving the moon; whatever the strength, it cools off any burn (from any source).
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of receiving the moon it spends %3$s PP, recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.preference.a: Without a burn, below this health ratio the companion schedules Moonlight; lower endures longer, higher receives the moon at the first wound. While burned it ignores this and puts out the fire first.
On: only cast under a clear night, holding the move by day. Off: cast whenever wounded and accept the floor heal. A burn to cool overrides this.
It cannot be used at full health unless the user is burned; if the wind-up is interrupted, neither the heal nor the burn cure resolves.
